note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; holotype from Tatuf, Brazil. Measurements translated verbatim from Table 28 of the original, in millimetres, the sample including small soldiers from the same nest. The original did not describe the alate or the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Close to C. villosus, but in this species the sides of the head are less curved, the short hair blanket sparser, and the anterior margin of the pronotum not concave or with only a barely perceptible notch. A population from Piraputanga, Brazil, contains both normal-sized soldiers and distinctly undersized ones; about 1/3 of the measurements in Table 28 of the original were taken from these small soldiers, so the means are low.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and pronotum pale yellow, abdomen pale yellow. Vertex covered with many setae and densely covered with short hairs; front of the postmentum with a few setae and covered with short hairs; pronotum with setae and some short hairs; tergites with setae only, without short hairs; sternites with hairs and setae. Head moderately thick, sides straight or slightly curved, nearly parallel; in large specimens a shallow depression on each side of the middle of the posterior margin. Frontal tube conical, just surpassing the base of the postclypeus from above, its upper margin nearly continuous with the vertex in lateral view. Narrowest part of the postmentum about 1/2 to 2/3 of the greatest width (0.35—0.43:0.62—0.71 mm). Antennae 15-segmented. Sides of the labrum evenly curved or bluntly rounded behind the base of the white median lobe. Right mandibular notch usually slightly less than a right angle, but in one large specimen the notch is wider and forms a right angle. Anterior margin of the pronotum not concave or with only a barely perceptible notch. Measurements (mm; original Table 28, n=21—35, means in parentheses, including small soldiers): head length including mandibles 4.00—5.00 (4.51); head length to the tip of the frontal tube 2.53—3.54 (3.07); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 2.79—3.78 (3.36); head width 2.06—2.76 (2.45); head thickness 1.48—1.85 (1.73); frontal tube length 0.23—0.44 (0.33); labrum width 0.71—0.85 (0.80); left mandible length 1.44—1.68 (1.56); right mandible length from the notch 0.76—0.86 (0.80); pronotum length 0.63—0.77 (0.69); pronotum width 1.12—1.41 (1.30); hind tibia length 1.76—2.18 (1.98).
